title: NRF24L01 Wireless MONSTER
tagline: Teleoperation over the airwaves! Send 2.4GHz radio packets between two Arduinos to control robots from across the room.

phases.instructions: Collect 2x Arduino boards, 2x NRF24L01+ 2.4GHz transceivers, 2x 10uF electrolytic capacitors, SG90 servo motor, and joystick.
verificationCheckpoints: 2x 10uF filter capacitors ready (vital for RF stability)
2x Arduino boards ready (e.g. Uno and Nano)

phases.instructions: WARNING: NRF24L01 requires strictly 3.3V power (5V destroys chip!). Connect CE to Pin 7, CSN to Pin 8, SCK to Pin 13, MOSI to Pin 11, MISO to Pin 12. Solder or place a 10uF capacitor directly across VCC and GND pins!
DOUBLE-CHECK POWER: Check the 3.3V rail. NRF24 draws high-frequency current bursts; without the 10uF capacitor, the radio may fail to initialize.
verificationCheckpoints: Decoupling capacitor polarity correct (stripe is negative)

phases.instructions: Review the RF24 protocol: opening write/read pipes, packing 32-byte payload structs, and receiving verified ACK packets.
phases.codeExplanation:
- radio.begin() configures Nordic 2.4GHz GFSK transceiver hardware.
- openWritingPipe sets a 5-byte physical radio frequency address shared between transmitter and receiver.
- sizeof(PacketData) packs telemetry into an atomic radio frame transmitted at 1 Mbps.
- Receiver unpacks data and drives servos with sub-5ms latency.
verificationCheckpoints: Understand struct packet serialization and deserialization

phases.instructions: Upload transmitter code to Node 1 and receiver code to Node 2. Move 10 meters away and manipulate joystick to watch the remote servo respond instantly!
verificationCheckpoints: Remote servo moves in real-time across the room

phases.instructions: Wireless Mastery! You built a robust 2.4GHz teleoperation radio link for long-range robotics.
verificationCheckpoints: Ready to claim Wireless Wizard badge

variants.title: Bi-Directional Telemetry Handshake
variants.description: Send sensor packets back from receiver to transmitter node to display remote stats.
variants.codeAdaptation: Use radio.writeAckPayload() or swap TX/RX roles dynamically

extensionMissions.title: Long-Range RF Channel Hopping
extensionMissions.objective: Implement dynamic channel hopping across 2.400GHz-2.525GHz to evade WiFi 2.4GHz interference.
hints: Change radio.setChannel() using a shared pseudo-random sequence

story: Master Long-Range Wireless Robot Teleoperation! Establish a 2.4 GHz digital packet radio link between two Arduinos using NRF24L01+ transceivers. Command robotic servos and steering mechanisms over the air from across the room!

troubleshooting.symptom: radio.begin() fails or packets drop frequently
troubleshooting.cause: 3.3V rail voltage droop or missing filter capacitor
troubleshooting.solution: Add a 10uF electrolytic capacitor directly across the NRF24 module's VCC and GND pins.
diagnosticSteps: Add a 10uF capacitor across NRF24L01 VCC and GND pins.
Ensure VCC is connected to 3.3V only (not 5V).
